info.name: DistillAI (Papero) API
info.description:
# DistillAI (Papero) — Full API Collection

AI-powered summarization platform for pharmaceutical researchers. Built with **Next.js 14 App Router**, **Prisma (PostgreSQL/Neon)**, **Redis caching**, **Google Gemini** and **NextAuth (credentials + JWT session cookies)**.

---

## 🚀 Getting Started

1. Start the dev server: `npm run dev` → runs on **http://localhost:3001**
2. Import this collection into Postman.
3. Run the **Auth → Get CSRF Token** request (auto-saves `csrfToken`).
4. Run **Auth → Sign In (Credentials)** with the seeded accounts below — Postman automatically stores the `next-auth.session-token` cookie, which authenticates every other request.
5. Response IDs (`summaryId`, `apiKeyId`, `userId`) are auto-captured into collection variables by the request test scripts, so dependent requests fill themselves in.

## 🔑 Seeded Accounts (from `prisma/seed.ts`)

| Role | Email | Password |
|---|---|---|
| ADMIN | `admin@distill.com` | `admin123` |
| RESEARCHER | `drrajeshkumar@example.com` (and 14 more `@example.com` accounts) | `password123` |

To switch accounts, edit `{{email}}` / `{{password}}` on the **Sign In** request and re-run it.

## 🔐 Authentication Model

- All protected routes read the **NextAuth JWT session cookie** (`next-auth.session-token` over HTTP / `__Secure-…` over HTTPS). There are no API-key-protected endpoints — keys are stored/managed only.
- **Roles (RBAC):** `ADMIN` > `RESEARCHER` > `VIEWER`.
  - Owners can read/modify **their own** resources; ADMIN can access anyone's.
  - `/api/admin/*` requires `role === ADMIN` (returns `403` otherwise).
  - `PATCH /api/user/{id}/password` allows **self only** (admins too are rejected for other users).
- `POST /api/register` is public. `POST /api/summarize` and `POST /api/parse-pdf` work without a session but attribute the summary to the first RESEARCHER as a fallback.

## 🧭 Route Map (28 requests)

| Folder | Route | Methods | Auth |
|---|---|---|---|
| Auth | `/api/register` | POST | Public |
| Auth | `/api/auth/*` (NextAuth) | GET/POST | Public |
| Summarization | `/api/summarize` | POST | Optional session |
| Summarization | `/api/parse-pdf` | POST | Optional session (cookie forwarded) |
| Summaries | `/api/summaries` | GET | Session |
| Summaries | `/api/summary/{id}` | GET, DELETE | Session (owner/ADMIN) |
| Feedback | `/api/feedback` | GET, POST | Session |
| API Keys | `/api/keys` | GET, POST | Session |
| API Keys | `/api/keys/{id}` | DELETE | Session (owner/ADMIN) |
| User | `/api/user/{id}` | PATCH, DELETE | Session (self/ADMIN) |
| User | `/api/user/{id}/password` | PATCH | Session (self only) |
| Dashboard | `/api/dashboard/stats` | GET | Session |
| Admin | `/api/admin/users` | GET | ADMIN |
| Admin | `/api/admin/users/{id}` | PATCH | ADMIN |
| Admin | `/api/admin/keys` | GET, POST | ADMIN |
| Admin | `/api/admin/summaries` | GET | ADMIN |
| Admin | `/api/admin/stats` | GET | ADMIN |
| Admin | `/api/admin/analytics` | GET | ADMIN |
| Admin | `/api/admin/feedback/analytics` | GET | ADMIN |

## 📚 External Dependencies

- **PubMed (NCBI E-UTILS)** — `/api/summarize?pmid` fetches metadata from `https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/efetch.fcgi`.
- **Gemini `gemini-2.5-flash`** — generates the structured summary; auto-retries on 429 rate limits (up to 3 retries, capped 65s wait).
- **Redis** — caches papers (7 days, `paper:pmid:{id}`) and summaries (24h, `summary:pmid:{id}`).

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Registration and NextAuth (credentials provider, JWT session) endpoints.

⚠️ **Login flow for Postman:** run **Get CSRF Token** first (stores `{{csrfToken}}`), then **Sign In (Credentials)**. Postman saves the returned session cookie automatically and reuses it for all protected requests in this collection.

request.description:
**POST /api/register** — Public user registration.

**Body:**
- `name` (string, required)
- `email` (string, required, unique)
- `password` (string, required) — hashed with bcrypt (10 rounds) before storage.

**Behavior:** Rejects duplicate emails. New users get role `RESEARCHER` by default.

**Responses:**
- `201` → `{ message, user: { id, email, name } }`
- `400` → `{ message: "Missing required fields" }` or `{ message: "User already exists" }`
- `500` → `{ message: "Internal server error" }`

**GET /api/auth/csrf** — NextAuth: returns a CSRF token required by sign-in / sign-out POSTs.

**Response `200`:** `{ "csrfToken": "..." }`

urlencoded.description: Use {{admin_email}} for admin routes or {{researcher_email}} for researcher routes
Required by NextAuth to get a JSON response instead of a redirect

request.description:
**POST /api/auth/callback/credentials** — NextAuth sign-in with the credentials provider.

**Behavior:** Verifies email + bcrypt password against the `User` table, then issues a JWT session cookie (`next-auth.session-token`). The JWT embeds `id` and `role`, exposed on the session as `session.user.id` / `session.user.role`.

**Important:** Run **Get CSRF Token** first so `{{csrfToken}}` is populated and Postman stores the CSRF cookie.

**Responses:**
- `200` → session established (success URL `/dashboard`)
- `401` → invalid credentials
- `302` → redirect (if `json: true` omitted)

**GET /api/auth/session** — Returns the current NextAuth session.

**Response `200` (authenticated):**
```json
{
  "user": { "name": "...", "email": "...", "id": "cuid", "role": "ADMIN" },
  "expires": "..."
}
```

**Response `200` (anonymous):** `{}` — empty object.

Handy for verifying which account the stored cookie belongs to.

exec: console.log("No active session — sign in first.");

request.description:
**GET /api/auth/providers** — Lists configured NextAuth providers.

**Response `200`:** `{ "credentials": { "id": "credentials", "name": "credentials", "type": "credentials", "signinUrl": ".../api/auth/signin/credentials", "callbackUrl": "..." } }`

**POST /api/auth/signout** — Clears the JWT session cookie.

Run **Get CSRF Token** again afterwards if you plan to sign in as another account.

item.name: Summarization
item.description:
Core AI endpoints: summarize a paper by PMID or raw PDF text, and upload a PDF file (parsed via `pdf2json`, then forwarded internally to `/api/summarize`).

Workflow: Redis cache check → PubMed fetch (if PMID) → Gemini `gemini-2.5-flash` with feedback-aware system prompt → persist `Paper` + `Summary` → cache result (24h).

request.description:
**POST /api/summarize** — Generate an AI summary for a research paper.

**Body (either one is required):**
- `pmid` (string) — numeric PubMed ID. Metadata (title/abstract/authors) fetched from NCBI E-UTILS; result cached in Redis for 24h.
- `pdfText` (string) — raw paper text, **min 100 chars**. First 30,000 chars are sent to Gemini.

**Validation (zod):** `pmid` must match `/^\d+$/`; request fails with `400` if neither field is present.

**Behavior:**
- Injects recent critical feedback (rating ≤ 3 with comments) into the Gemini system prompt — the feedback loop improves future summaries.
- Auto-retries on Gemini `429` (up to 3 retries, waits up to 65s — expect slow responses when rate-limited).
- Persists `Paper` (upsert by `pubmedId`, or `pdf-{timestamp}` for PDFs) and a `Summary` with status `COMPLETED`, model `gemini-2.5-flash`.
- Without a session, the summary is attributed to the first `RESEARCHER` user.

**Response `200` (example):**
```json
{
  "keyFindings": "...",
  "methodology": "...",
  "conclusions": "...",
  "limitations": "...",
  "paperTitle": "...",
  "year": "2024",
  "processingTimeMs": 8123,
  "id": "cuid-of-summary"
}
```

**Errors:** `400` invalid JSON / validation · `404` `{ error: "Abstract not found for this PMID." }` · `502` PubMed or Gemini/JSON-parse failure · `500` unexpected.

formdata.description: A research paper PDF (validated by extension `.pdf` or MIME type `application/pdf`)

request.description:
**POST /api/parse-pdf** — multipart/form-data upload of a PDF.

**Pipeline:**
1. Validates the file is a PDF (`400` otherwise).
2. Extracts text with `pdf2json` (`422` if empty / scanned image-only / < 100 chars).
3. Forwards `{ pdfText }` internally to `/api/summarize`, passing along your session cookie.

**Response `200`** = summarize response **plus** `pdfFileName` and `extractedTextLength`.

**Errors:** `400` no file / wrong type · `422` unreadable or too-short text · `4xx/5xx` mirrored from the summarize call.

item.name: Summaries
item.description: Read and delete summaries. Ownership rule: users see only their own summaries unless `role === ADMIN`.

query.description: Optional — target user. Defaults to session user; ADMIN only can query other users
Case-insensitive search on paper title or PubMed ID
Only summaries having a feedback with overallRating <= value (low-quality filter)

request.description:
**GET /api/summaries** — Paginated list of the session user's summaries (ADMIN may pass `userId` to view others).

**Response `200` (example):**
```json
{
  "summaries": [
    {
      "id": "cuid",
      "paperTitle": "...",
      "pmid": "32289690",
      "year": "2024",
      "dateAdded": "Sep 24, 2026",
      "rating": 4,
      "keyFindings": "...",
      "methodology": "...",
      "conclusions": "...",
      "limitations": "...",
      "isPdf": false
    }
  ],
  "pagination": { "total": 1, "page": 1, "limit": 10, "totalPages": 1 }
}
```

**Errors:** `401` Unauthorized (no session) · `403` Forbidden (querying another user as non-ADMIN) · `500`.

exec: console.log("No summaries yet — run POST /api/summarize first.");

request.description:
**GET /api/summary/{id}** — Full detail of one summary, including paper record and averaged feedback rating.

**Response `200` (example):**
```json
{
  "id": "cuid",
  "paperTitle": "...",
  "pmid": "32289690",
  "year": "2024",
  "dateAdded": "Sep 24, 2026",
  "rating": 4,
  "keyFindings": "...",
  "methodology": "...",
  "conclusions": "...",
  "limitations": "...",
  "isPdf": false
}
```

**Errors:** `401` Unauthorized · `403` Forbidden (not owner, not ADMIN) · `404` Summary not found · `500`.

variable.description: Summary cuid — deleting cascades its Feedback rows (Prisma onDelete: Cascade)

request.description:
**DELETE /api/summary/{id}** — Owner or ADMIN only.

**Response `200`:** `{ "message": "Summary deleted successfully" }`

**Errors:** `401` · `403` · `404` · `500`.

item.name: Feedback
item.description: User feedback on summaries. Feeding low ratings (≤ 3) with comments back into `/api/summarize` is the app's continuous-improvement loop.

query.description: Optional — defaults to session user; ADMIN can query other users

request.description:
**POST /api/feedback** — Submit feedback.

**Body:**
- `type` (required) — free-form tag, e.g. `summary`, `bug`, `general` (stored as `[type] message` in the comment).
- `message` (required) — feedback text.
- `rating` (optional, 1–5) — defaults to 5; applied to `overallRating`, `accuracyRating` and `coherenceRating`.
- `summaryId` (optional) — if omitted, the feedback is attached to the user's latest summary.

**Response `201`:** `{ "message": "Feedback submitted successfully", "id": "cuid" }`

**Errors:** `401` · `400` missing fields · `500` (also fails if the user has no summaries and `summaryId` is required by the DB).

item.name: API Keys
item.description: Personal API key management for the session user. Keys are generated as `papero_{64-hex}`. Tier limits: `BASIC` 1000 · `RESEARCHER` 10000 · `ADMIN` 50000.

query.description: Optional — defaults to session user; ADMIN can view other users' keys

request.description:
**GET /api/keys** — API keys owned by the session user (newest first).

**Response `200` (example):**
```json
{
  "keys": [
    {
      "id": "cuid",
      "name": "My Mac Key",
      "maskedKey": "papero••••••••ab12",
      "key": "papero_...(full key)",
      "tier": "BASIC",
      "created": "Sep 24, 2026",
      "usage": 12,
      "limit": 1000
    }
  ]
}
```

**Errors:** `401` · `403` · `500`.

**POST /api/keys** — Create a new API key for the session user.

**Body:**
- `name` (required) — display name.
- `role` (optional) — maps to tier & monthly limit: `BASIC` (default, 1000), `RESEARCHER` (10000), `ADMIN` (50000).

**Response `201` (example):**
```json
{
  "message": "API Key created",
  "key": "papero_9f2c...(raw key — shown once here but also stored retrievable via GET)",
  "apiKey": { "id": "cuid", "name": "...", "maskedKey": "...", "tier": "BASIC", "created": "Sep 24, 2026", "usage": 0, "limit": 1000 }
}
```

**Errors:** `401` · `400` missing name · `500`.

variable.description: ApiKey cuid (auto-captured when creating a key)

request.description:
**DELETE /api/keys/{id}** — Permanently deletes the key. Owner or ADMIN only.

**Response `200`:** `{ "message": "API Key revoked successfully" }`

**Errors:** `401` · `403` · `404` API Key not found · `500`.

💡 For a soft revoke (`isActive: false`) as ADMIN, see **Admin → Revoke Any Key**.

item.name: User
item.description: Profile self-service endpoints. `PATCH`/`DELETE` allow self or ADMIN; the password change endpoint allows **self only**.

variable.description: User cuid — defaults to the session user via auto-captured variable

request.description:
**PATCH /api/user/{id}** — Update profile (self or ADMIN only).

**Body:** `name` is the only field persisted by the current schema (`jobTitle` / `organization` are accepted but not stored).

**Response `200`:** `{ "message": "Profile updated successfully", "user": { "id": "cuid", "name": "..." } }`

**Errors:** `401` · `403` (not self/ADMIN) · `404` unknown id · `500`.

variable.description: User cuid — deleting cascades ApiKey rows; Summary/Feedback rows reference the user

request.description:
**DELETE /api/user/{id}** — Permanently deletes the account (self or ADMIN only).

**Response `200`:** `{ "message": "Account deleted successfully" }`

**Errors:** `401` · `403` · `404` · `500` (FK conflicts if the user still owns summaries/feedback).

⚠️ Destructive — the seeded researcher accounts are used by the analytics dashboards.

variable.description: Must be the session user's own id — even ADMINs cannot change other users' passwords here

request.description:
**PATCH /api/user/{id}/password** — Change your own password (self only, verified against the session).

**Body:**
- `currentPassword` (required) — checked with bcrypt.
- `newPassword` (required) — hashed with bcrypt (10 rounds).

**Response `200`:** `{ "message": "Password updated successfully" }`

**Errors:** `401` · `403` (id ≠ session user) · `400` missing fields or incorrect current password · `404` user not found · `500`.

item.name: Dashboard
item.description: Aggregated stats for the logged-in user's dashboard.

item.name: Admin
item.description:
ADMIN-only management & analytics endpoints (role check: `session.user.role === 'ADMIN'`; otherwise `403`). Sign in with `admin@distill.com` / `admin123`.

⚠️ Some analytics contain demo/mock values (`dailyUsage` scaling, `weeklyUsagePerKey` random calls, static `trends`).

variable.description: Target user cuid (auto-captured from List Users / Register)

request.description:
**PATCH /api/admin/users/{id}** — Change a user's role (ADMIN only).

**Body:** `role` (required) — one of `ADMIN`, `RESEARCHER`, `VIEWER` (validated).

**Response `200`:** `{ "message": "Role updated", "user": { "id": "cuid", "role": "VIEWER" } }`

**Errors:** `403` · `400` missing/invalid role · `404` unknown id (Prisma) · `500`.

**POST /api/admin/keys** — Soft-revoke any key (ADMIN only): sets `isActive: false`.

**Body:** `id` (required) — the ApiKey cuid.

**Response `200`:** `{ "message": "Key revoked successfully" }`

**Errors:** `403` · `400` missing id · `500`.

💡 This flips status to `"Revoked"` in Admin → List All API Keys. Hard delete lives at `DELETE /api/keys/{id}`.

query.description: Filter by paper title or PubMed ID (case-insensitive contains)
One of: PDF | PubMed | Highly Rated (rating >= 4) | Needs Review (0 < rating < 3)
One of: Newest (default) | Oldest | Highest Rated | Lowest Rated

request.description:
**GET /api/admin/stats** — Admin home KPIs (ADMIN only).

**Response `200` (example):**
```json
{
  "totalUsers": 16,
  "totalSummaries": 45,
  "avgRating": "4.2",
  "callsToday": 3,
  "activeKeys": 8,
  "recentActivity": [
    { "time": "5 mins ago", "text": "Dr. Rajesh Kumar summarized \"CRISPR-Cas9 Editing..." }
  ],
  "topResearcher": { "name": "Dr. Anjali Desai", "summaries": 9 }
}
```

`callsToday` counts summaries created since local midnight; `recentActivity` merges the 3 newest summaries and 2 newest feedbacks.

**Errors:** `403` · `500`.

**GET /api/admin/analytics** — Charts data (ADMIN only).

**Response `200` (example):**
```json
{
  "ratingDistribution": [ { "stars": 5, "count": 12, "pct": 48 }, { "stars": 4, "count": 8, "pct": 32 }, { "stars": 3, "count": 3, "pct": 12 }, { "stars": 2, "count": 1, "pct": 4 }, { "stars": 1, "count": 1, "pct": 4 } ],
  "dailyUsage": [ { "day": "Sep 11", "calls": 34 }, ... 14 days ],
  "recentFeedback": [ { "id": "cuid", "rating": 5, "comment": "Great summary...", "paper": "...", "date": "Sep 24" } ],
  "trends": { "mostSummarized": "CRISPR-Cas9 Editing (mock)", "activeResearcher": "Dr. Jane Smith (142)", "peakHour": "2:00 PM - 3:00 PM EST" }
}
```

Notes: `dailyUsage` covers the last 14 days (call counts scaled ×5 for low usage, or mocked when zero); missing comments get a canned comment based on rating; `trends` is static mock data.

**Errors:** `401` (non-ADMIN) · `500`.
